name: Maltese Press
description: An extremely advanced rings movement where the arms are held below horizontal in a wide position, lower than a standard iron cross. The body must press up from this compromised position, requiring extraordinary pectoral and anterior deltoid strength. This is competition-level gymnastics.

execution.starting_position: Set up for Maltese Press in proper position.
execution.setup_instructions: Prepare body and equipment for Maltese Press.
steps: Step 1: From an iron cross position, lower arms below shoulder height into Maltese.
Step 2: Maintain body horizontal while arms are at approximately hip level.
Step 3: Press rings back up and inward to transition to another position.
Step 4: Requires exceptional prerequisite strength in iron cross first.
execution.breathing_instructions: Breathe steadily; never hold breath during static holds.
safety_considerations: Build prerequisite strength before attempting advanced variations.
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full range of motion with control at all times.
coaching_cues: Develop iron cross before approaching this
